Normalized Heritage (RFI v1.0). Ported to Roll for Initiation: 7-damage-type canon, Soma Break, Tier-based scaling, reroll-lowest. Replaces the D&D5E heritage draft dated 2026-04-19 00:10.

“Something fell into you and it’s still awake in there.”

Qliph-Scarred (Diabolic). Mode: inhabited. The scar has an opinion. You host it. You do not obey it.

Heritage Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Qliph-Scarred).
  • Size. Medium. Speed: normal.
  • Splinter Tongue. You understand the Infernal Lexicon. Reroll the lowest die on Presence-channel deception checks against creatures willing to lie to themselves.
  • Inside Voice. The thing inside speaks when you let it — see What’s Inside You, your signature feat.
  • Unpleasant Proximity. Cold iron and consecrated steel carry narrative weight against you; the GM may describe them as burning, sickening, or making your scar shake. Pure flavor until the Phase 3 vulnerability engine lands.
  • Signature. You gain What’s Inside You at character creation.

Engine note. Where this heritage grants a damage-type resistance, it is applied by the fourththing defense engine via flags.fourththing.grants. Narrative immunities (sleep, forced movement, cold iron) are descriptive only until the Phase 3 condition-and-flavor engine ships.

advancement.hint: Gain the Qliph-Scarred (Diabolic) signature feat: What's Inside You.
